description: A rounded box with a blurred drop shadow -- the shadow must follow the rounded outline and stay hidden behind the box, validated against Chromium's own rendering.

florui.css: .box { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 8px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }

classification.reason: Two independent Gaussian blurs plus a curved shadow edge. Measured against desktop Chrome: 15.1% of pixels differ (mean_error 0.243, max_error 31), geometry an exact 40x40 match. The limit is set well above that because the sibling box-shadow-blur fixture measured almost 3x worse on a software-rendered CI Chromium than on desktop; this one has not been measured there.
